limitations: Encrypted SDRAM validated separately by ModelSim; encrypted HDMI core not simulated
External SD/HDMI electrical interface delays and board jitter not fully signed off
BMP supports root IMG01..IMG04 8.3 names, BITMAPINFOHEADER 40, BGR24 uncompressed 1..1024 width/height, scaled to 640x480
Guide audio: root MUSIC.WAV and NARR01..NARR04.WAV, 48 kHz 16-bit stereo canonical PCM
Card subtitles: root SUB01..SUB04.BIN, 2048 bytes each, clusters >= 2 KB (4 sectors)
Exhibition view (SW2 down): bilinear only, silent without a card; maintenance (SW2 up): SW4 A/B and 1 kHz test tone
Tour dwell is content-driven (narration + one caption pass, 6..90 s); manual turn pauses, 60 s idle resumes
Seven-segment display needs SW6 up (shared with the bicolour LEDs)
Maintenance view: KEY2/KEY3 short = volume +/-, third header row UP/VOL/RCV
UART log 115200 8N1 on the CH340 port, one time-stamped line per event
Alarm buzzer on H11 (SW5 hardware switch cuts it)
SD auto-recovery: init watchdog 3 s, NO IMAGE retry 10 s, guide-reader retry 10 s (no KEY1 needed)
Standby: KEY2+KEY3 2 s; HDMI serialiser reset, card reading paused, display/LEDs off; any key wakes
M14 needs board verification of standby/wake on the real monitor, display idle, dwell setting and all M13 functions
